title: Dark Window
description: A simple mod that makes the game window dark.
body:
Dark Game Window is a simple mod that makes the Minecraft game window dark, removing the default bright background and reducing eye strain.

It’s perfect for playing at night, streaming, or just creating a more comfortable visual experience. The mod does not affect gameplay, performance, or in-game graphics — it only changes the appearance of the game window.

Features:

Dark Minecraft window interface

Minimalistic and unobtrusive style

No impact on FPS or gameplay

Lightweight and easy to install

Compatible with most mods and requires no additional configuration.
